annotations.title: List the subnets that charge an entry fee

description: Call this when choosing which Bittensor subnet to enter. It returns one row for every subnet whose entry fee is $1 or more, with the fee now, how many new entries are still in, what a new entry is paid a day today, how many days the fee takes to come back at that pay, and how last month's entries ended up.
name: list_contests
